'''Bronze''' was a metal alloy. It was used in the construction of the [[Reinforced Humanoid Torso]].<ref name="Droid">''[[Star Wars: DroidWorks]]''</ref> "'''Bronze-age'''" was sometimes used as a descriptor of a level of technological achievement. The [[Th'iruckai]] had attained a bronze-age level of technology before they encountered civilization from beyond their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Th'irus]].<ref name="HNT">{{WEGCite|story=Hostile Natives Of Th'irus|book=Star Wars Gamemaster Screen}}</ref> [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] had a bronze finish on side where a hull brace had broken, which bother him as he was fastidious.<ref name="ANHN" /> The first [[R-10 household droid]]s produced by [[Lovolan]] for the pleasure palaces on [[Hesperidium/Legends|Hesperidium]] were decorated with [[Color/Legends|green]] bronze plating. Bronze shutters were used to cover the optical lens of the [[TT-8L/XSS]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
